description: Approved spec for plant detail. Planted: overdue text uses an RGB literal equal to Color.thirsty; the notes caption is 13 pt in Figma but .caption (12) in code; the Hug primary button is built with fill: true (Width = Fill); Delete is red in Figma but forced to Color.leaf (wrong colour meaning, also against the CLAUDE.md rule); the History header is the first row instead of a Section header (CLAUDE.md rule). Decoys: .system(size: 13) for 13 pt text, unbound #000000 text matched by the default label colour, sample values, the button's own label font (component internals), white card hex fills (design note only).
prompt: Compare the built app with the Figma frame spec at _reports/design-sync/2026-10-14-plant-detail.json and report your findings.

must_find.why: Node 30:108 binds color/thirsty; code hard-codes the RGB instead of Color.thirsty.
Node 30:111 is 13 pt Regular (.footnote); code uses .caption (12 pt).
Instance 30:116 is Width=Hug; code stretches it.
Node 30:118 binds Accents/Red; code overrides the destructive role with Color.leaf, against the 'destructive uses system red' rule.
Node 30:112 is a header outside the card; code makes it the first row, which CLAUDE.md forbids.

must_not_flag.why: Unbound #000000 text matched by the default label colour; values are data-driven and match the format.
Text inside the Primary Button instance belongs to the component; body semibold = 17 Semi Bold anyway.
'Monstera' is a sample value; navigationTitle draws the large title.
